Mini Golf

  1. Six holes, each on its own island. Drag back from anywhere and let go to putt: the ball goes the opposite way to your drag, harder the longer you pull.
  2. The dotted line shows the first stretch of the roll, bounces off the rails included.
  3. Sand slows the ball, the chevrons on a slope push it downhill, and water costs a stroke. On the last hole, time your putt between the windmill's sails.
  4. Roll in gently: a ball moving too fast lips out. After seven strokes you pick up and score eight.
  5. On a keyboard: left and right arrows aim, hold space for power and let go.
